title: Settings menu
summary: Compact settings: a list of settings given as data, drawn as a menu that opens from a trigger or stands inline -- rows with the value under the name that open their choices in place (drill, the default), or rows with the control at the end (rows), with an optional block of tiles on top. A special case of the context menu, for a reader's settings, a table's view options, a chat's settings.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

label.description: The panel's heading and accessible name; «Настройки» / «Settings» in the page language when not set

heading.description: The heading row on top of the panel; heading="false" leaves it out (a panel that names the settings itself)

inline.description: Always open in the page's flow, for a settings panel or a sidebar; without it the panel opens from the trigger slot or the for target

for.description: The id of a control elsewhere in the page that opens the panel, when the trigger is not in the trigger slot

placement.description: Where the popup panel hangs from its trigger; it flips and shifts to stay in the window

size.description: The ladder rung of the rows, as sf-context-menu's: a row is the control height of the size (32 px at 1/2, the default, 40 px at 1), taller by the value's line under a name

resettable.description: A reset row at the end: every item that declares a default goes back to it

reset-label.description: The reset row's text; «Сбросить» / «Reset» in the page language when not set

back-label.description: The back button's name in a choice list; «Назад» / «Back» in the page language when not set

items.description: The settings, as data: a property, or the JSON island <script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": […]}</script> in the host. The component keeps and reports the values; what a value means is the page's

open.summary: Opens the popup panel; refused when the menu is inline, has no trigger, or a page cancels sf-settings-menu-open

close.summary: Closes the popup panel; refused when it is closed already or a page cancels sf-settings-menu-close

toggle.summary: Opens the popup panel when it is closed and closes it when it is open

reset.summary: Puts every item that declares a default back to it; refused when a page cancels sf-settings-menu-reset

sf-settings-menu-change.summary: A person asks to change a setting: a request a page may cancel, and the value stays

sf-settings-menu-changed.summary: A setting changed; the page applies what the value means

sf-settings-menu-apply.summary: An action row was chosen (vocabulary §5 apply, scope entry, ids the row's key); the page does the action. A popup closes unless a listener cancels it

sf-settings-menu-reset.summary: A person asks to put the settings back to their defaults; keys are the items that would change. Cancelled, nothing changes; otherwise each one sends changed

sf-settings-menu-open.summary: The popup panel is about to open: a request a page may cancel

sf-settings-menu-close.summary: The popup panel is about to close, and why (§19.3): the trigger pressed again (close), Escape, a press outside, or the action and Tab (api)

sf-settings-menu-closed.summary: The popup panel closed, and why

forbidden_client_responsibilities: applying what a value means (a theme, a density, a text size)
drawing a settings row of its own

keyboard: Arrow Up and Down move between the rows; Home and End go to the first and the last
Arrow Right or Enter on a choice row opens its list in place; Arrow Left or Escape goes back
Enter or Space activates: a switch toggles, a pill or an option is chosen
Escape on the top level closes the popup and gives focus back to the trigger; Tab leaves and closes it
accessibility.focus: Opening the popup focuses its first row; a choice list focuses its chosen option; going back focuses the row it came from; closing gives focus back to the trigger.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-settings-menu for a small set of settings a person changes on the spot: a reader's theme and text size, a table's view options, a chat's settings -- in a popup from a gear button or inline in a panel.
do_not: Do not draw a settings popover of your own from buttons and switches
Do not set the panel's width per page; it is fixed and --sf-settings-menu-inline-size changes it for an area
Do not expect the component to apply a theme or save the values: listen for sf-settings-menu-changed and do it in the page
